(d) Posture — ZERO wait-for-the-flush entries (4 enter_now_carry, 4 scale_in, 2 on_confirmation gated on DIFFERENT dated events), so no correlated timing bet exists if flushes arrive together; sequencing assumes they do. (e) EUROPEAN-CYCLICAL-RECESSION + CORRELATED DE-GROSS stress: direct casualties are FRVIA.PA (levered, the identified tail) and partially EEFT/CTSH (capped at 2.5 units combined); AAUC (gold cash-out), FIP/KBR (US event-carried), CMCSA/THC/UHS (US domestic defensive) are insensitive; NTES defends on net cash — the book survives the scenario with the capped Euro-beta sleeve as the worst leg: PASS. SECULAR-THEME CONCENTRATION: reimbursement-compression carries 2 names (THC+UHS, both NARROW moats so neither counts at half) — resolved KEPT-WITH-CAP: combined_caps {THC, UHS, max 1.5 units, axis secular-theme:reimbursement-compression}; the shared headwind is a dated, partial, phased-from-2028 haircut already marked at trough multiples, not an open-ended melt.
